name: bundle-env-read-far-from-unrelated-fetch
note: A bundle (aws-cdk, pdfkit's vendored yarn, simple-bin-help) where an env iteration from one module and a fetch from an unrelated module are concatenated megabytes apart into one file. The bulk-env + network token-exfil HIGH now requires the harvest and the network call to be in proximity, not merely in the same file, so bundle co-tenants that never interact do not corroborate each other. A compact dropper that reads the env and sends it in the same place still blocks. (Review, not safe: the standalone bulk-env read is still surfaced as an environment-access medium.) Regression guard for the deeper-corpus false-block fixes.
